verdict.rationale: While a GitHub repo (supermemoryai/supermemory) is referenced for feature descriptions, and community evidence notes a separate 'open-source MCP' layer, there is no evidence of an actual open-source license for the core Supermemory engine — self-hosting docs describe distribution as a compiled 'self-contained binary' rather than source code, which cuts against an open-license claim for the product itself.
